import java.util.*;
public class Main {
    static final int INF = 0x7f7f7f7f;
    static int n, m, s, t, p, c, d;
    static int[] x = new int[505], y = new int[505];
    static int mxf, mnc;
    static int ee = 1;
    static int[] h = new int[5000005], nex = new int[10000010], to = new int[10000010], val = new int[10000010], cost = new int[10000010];
    static int[] dis = new int[5000005], pre = new int[5000005], last = new int[5000005], flow = new int[5000005];
    static boolean[] vis = new boolean[5000005];

    static void add_edge(int x, int y, int z, int cst) {
        nex[++ee] = h[x];
        to[ee] = y;
        val[ee] = z;
        cost[ee] = cst;
        h[x] = ee;
    }

    static boolean spfa() {
        Arrays.fill(dis, INF);
        Arrays.fill(vis, false);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        vis[s] = true;
        dis[s] = 0;
        flow[s] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        pre[t] = -1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int x = q.poll();
            vis[x] = false;
            for (int i = h[x]; i != 0; i = nex[i]) {
                if (val[i] > 0 && dis[to[i]] > dis[x] + cost[i]) {
                    dis[to[i]] = dis[x] + cost[i];
                    pre[to[i]] = x;
                    last[to[i]] = i;
                    flow[to[i]] = Math.min(flow[x], val[i]);
                    if (!vis[to[i]]) {
                        vis[to[i]] = true;
                        q.offer(to[i]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return pre[t] != -1;
    }

    static void min_cost_max_flow() {
        mxf = 0;
        mnc = 0;
        while (spfa()) {
            int now = t;
            mxf += flow[t];
            mnc += flow[t] * dis[t];
            while (now != s) {
                val[last[now]] -= flow[t];
                val[last[now] ^ 1] += flow[t];
                now = pre[now];
            }
        }
    }

    static int node_id(int layer, int node) {
        return layer * n + node;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        p = sc.nextInt();
        c = sc.nextInt();
        d = sc.nextInt();
        s = 0;
        t = n * 99 + 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= p; i++) {
            int xVal = sc.nextInt();
            add_edge(s, node_id(0, xVal), 1, 0);
            add_edge(node_id(0, xVal), s, 0, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            x[i] = sc.nextInt();
            y[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= 99; i++) {
            add_edge(node_id(i, 1), node_id(i + 1, 1), INF, 0);
            add_edge(node_id(i + 1, 1), node_id(i, 1), 0, 0);
            for (int j = 2; j <= n; j++) {
                add_edge(node_id(i, j), node_id(i + 1, j), INF, c);
                add_edge(node_id(i + 1, j), node_id(i, j), 0, -c);
            }
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= p; k++) {
                    int cst = d * k * k - d * (k - 1) * (k - 1) + c;
                    add_edge(node_id(i, x[j]), node_id(i + 1, y[j]), 1, cst);
                    add_edge(node_id(i + 1, y[j]), node_id(i, x[j]), 0, -cst);
                    add_edge(node_id(i, y[j]), node_id(i + 1, x[j]), 1, cst);
                    add_edge(node_id(i + 1, x[j]), node_id(i, y[j]), 0, -cst);
                }
            }
        }
        min_cost_max_flow();
        System.out.println(mnc);
        sc.close();
    }
}
